title: I paused my game and my editor to focus on developing LSDE
author: djmisterjon
selftext:
**LSDE is available in beta** version if you are interested in testing the tool.  
Several features have been added **to support my game FCT7O** and is workflow with .  
Now my goal is to ensure that **LSDE can adapt to all types of workflows and architectures** used by game developers.  
  
**I support 11 editors and frameworks and the documentation is available**.  
If you encounter any issues or have feature requests for your game development or your custom engine and i18n, I am available and happy to help you.

*The software is not suited for vibecoders yet.*  
This will be maybe planned for later in the year.  
For now, it is intended for developers who enjoy old-school development while leveraging modern technologies for writing and translating their story.

I will try to be more active on social networks this year over the coming month in preparation for the launch.

If you would like to follow the progress and process on Bluesky, Discord, and Twitter.  
[https://bsky.app/profile/lepasoft.bsky.social/post/3megk32aaus2j](https://bsky.app/profile/lepasoft.bsky.social/post/3megk32aaus2j)
